text:
elena: quick follow-up from today's all-hands sec Q&A. capturing answers on SOC2/ISO artifacts, VPC connectivity, audit-log exports, and KMS/BYOK rotation. drop any follow-ups here.

dan: short bullets: hosted -> logs to our managed bucket `s3://redwood-logs/audit/<region>/`; Dedicated/Private -> export to customer bucket via cross-account role. default retention 90d; request 180/365 via the compliance form.

priya: evidence requests: use https://bit.ly/rwd-compliance. include `org`, `project`, `control_scope`, `evidence_owner`, and desired `retention_days`. expect 72-96h for full manual bundles. we provide control mappings + config snapshots + log slices.

aaron: VPC question: recommended pattern is Interface Endpoints (PrivateLink backing) for API/control-plane traffic. we do not recommend VPC peering for prod (routing/scale). eng-platform will do a 15m review for any custom network setup.

sam: KMS/BYOK details? rotation cadence? HSM?

elena: we support AWS CMKs, imported key material (BYOK), and HSM-backed flows. auto-rotation for AWS-managed CMKs supported. for imported keys you must provide rotation schedule during onboarding; we suggest 90d for high-sensitivity. HSM requires extra onboarding + attestation steps.

compliance-bot: Ticket COMP-4301 opened to track evidence & retention asks from this thread.

dan: quick example for Private export role (we'll post full snippet in #eng-docs):

```
aws iam create-role --role-name redwood-audit-exporter --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name redwood-audit-exporter --policy-name export-policy --policy-document file://export-policy.json
```

priya: operational note: if your workload uses KV/prefix caching, mention it in the evidence request so we can capture the right traces without affecting SLOs.

elena: office hours: security + eng-platform next Mon 11am PT for SOC2/ISO/VPC/KMS Qs. sign-up: https://meet.redwood.ai/sec-office. slides + checklist will be posted after.

sam: can you include sample S3 bucket policy and least-privilege IAM policy?

dan: yes i'll post a one-pager + sample bucket policy + role snippet in #eng-docs by EOD.

elena: closing loop for now. if urgent, @priya is the compliance owner and @dan is the platform owner for exports. thanks! :thumbsup:
